author: Cleo Abram
description:
Why do robots suck at using their hands?

Humanoid robots have come really far over the past decade. They’re doing backflips, dance routines, and breaking records on race tracks. Despite that there’s still one physical limitation most of them haven’t locked down just yet… Hands. Replicating the human hand is considered one of the biggest hurdles, but why is it so hard? 

To find out, subscribe!

#robotics #biology #science #explainer
title: Why Robots Suck At Hands
